says: In today's lead tooling, slice S3 of ticket 766 adds .agents/skills/lead/scripts/fieldrow.ts and fieldrow.test.ts but not to the include list of .agents/tsconfig.json, the project pnpm typecheck runs for the lead scripts. So pnpm typecheck never type-checks them or runs Effect's checks on them, and the build row's 'pnpm typecheck exited 0' says nothing about fieldrow.ts. Slice S2 added its new files there (governance.ts, governance.test.ts, git/*.ts on branch fabrikalfa/port-0113-s02); clauderow.ts, the twin of fieldrow.ts, is listed. Today both files are clean.
proof: At 8491d53, rg fieldrow .agents/tsconfig.json finds nothing. A scratch tsconfig that extends .agents/tsconfig.json and includes only the two files passes tsc with exit 0; the same scratch project with a planted type error and a planted dropped Effect fails with TS2322 and effect(floatingEffect), so the checks were live.
cost: A later edit to fieldrow.ts can break its types or drop an Effect and pass pnpm typecheck and CI.
next: Add skills/lead/scripts/fieldrow.ts and skills/lead/scripts/fieldrow.test.ts to .agents/tsconfig.json's include, in this integrator, as S2 did for its files.
